name: Joint-RMS ChordRes with bounded controls
tagline: Token-dependent steps with bounded lookahead and velocity writes.
description: The joint h/v gate predicts signed lookahead, positive position steps, retention and displacement gains through bounded activations at each sublayer.
mechanism: Jointly normalized position and velocity condition the bounded sublayer controls
Zero-start projections preserve the initial static model
Triton fuses per-token controls into the saved-force Chord path
limitations: Research run with matched random output projections and a high Chord learning rate.

nodes: Chord read, branch and tangent write
